title: mail-server Email history: get per version, onlyDestroyed query, restore, blob retention
description:
Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H5. Crates: jmap-mail-types, jmap-mail-server. Size: L.

Spec: object-history-03 §3, §3.1 (blob downloadable; non-current versions are not blob references), §3.2.2 and §4.1 examples, §5.1, §5.2 (Email keeps blobId), §5.3 example. Design: docs/design/object-history.md §5 ('Foo/get' step 8, 'Foo/query', 'Foo/queryChanges'), §7 Email bullet, §9 blobext and emailpush, §10.

Work:
- impl HistoryObject for Email.
- Factor the body-value processing out of handle_email_get into a helper and apply it per entry.
- Email history get, using the pub pieces.
- onlyDestroyed Email/query: collapseThreads ignored, default sort by destruction time descending. queryChanges routed by state kind (decision 6(c)).
- Restore keeps blobId and threadId; a vanished Thread gives a new threadId, reported in `restored`.
- Memory:
  - the blob store keeps blobs of retained versions alive
  - destroying a blob drops every version that references it, so the Email is gone (decision 6(d))
  - Blob/lookup and blobHasReference see current Emails only (decision 11 covers the legacy lookup too)
  - record onDestroyRemoveEmails and auto-expunge cascades

Acceptance: spec examples byte-for-byte except state:
- §3.2.2 Email/changes → #ids /destroyed → Email/get includeDestroyed
- §4.1 onlyDestroyed destroyedAfter limit 50 ⇒ ["email57","email42"] with canCalculateChanges:true, then queryChanges with only sinceQueryState after a restore ⇒ removed:["email42"]
- §5.3 restored {"email42": null}
Also: cascade destroys appear in includeDestroyed. CHANGELOG bullet, public-api.

Note for emailpush: its memory email_history flag follows this capability once this lands (docs/design/emailpush.md §9).
